items.source: Assert the controller method used to process the request.
items.translation: 断言用于处理请求的控制器方法。

items.source: Note: Expectations that assert the controller method used to process the request work only for requests processed with RequestMappingHandlerMapping and RequestMappingHandlerAdapter which is used by default with the Spring MVC Java config and XML namespace.
items.translation: 注意： 断言用于处理请求的控制器方法的期望，仅适用于使用 RequestMappingHandlerMapping 和 RequestMappingHandlerAdapter 处理的请求，后者是 Spring MVC Java 配置和 XML 命名空间的默认使用方式。

items.source: An instance of this class is typically accessed via MockMvcResultMatchers.handler().
items.translation: 该类的一个实例通常通过 MockMvcResultMatchers.handler() 访问。

items.source: The expected method is specified through a "mock" controller method invocation similar to MvcUriComponentsBuilder.fromMethodCall(Object).
items.translation: 预期的方法通过类似于 `MvcUriComponentsBuilder.fromMethodCall(Object)` 的“模拟”控制器方法调用来指定。

items.source: A test that has statically imported MvcUriComponentsBuilder.on(Class) can be performed as follows:

items.source: Assert the name of the controller method used to process the request using the given Hamcrest Matcher.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Hamcrest Matcher 断言用于处理请求的控制器方法名称。

items.translation: 断言处理该请求的处理器类型。
